name: Trip Planner
description: Plan a trip end to end, unique per placement. Space editors create trips and build each one out across three views: a day-by-day itinerary with times, activities, and places, a packing list grouped by category with live packed counts, and a running log of trip costs with a total. Places you name are looked up once and pinned on a map above the itinerary, so the whole trip reads at a glance. Everyone else, including anyone the frame is shared with publicly, sees a live read-only itinerary, so a share link doubles as the trip's printed handout. Trips live in encrypted LocalTables scoped to the placement, and every change is pushed live to all viewers.
